edges.reading: Esta ficha abre la lectura desde el documento de origen.
Desde «JubAp.EU», el enlace «Last articles» abre «Field Notes».
Desde «JubAp.EU», el enlace «Jump Up Business Action Plan» abre «The JUBAP Framework».
Desde «JubAp.EU», el enlace «strategic-reframing account» abre «Reframing Value Creation».
For a complementary reading, see [Human transformation: the perspective engine](https://jubap.eu/human-transformation/).
For a complementary reading, see [The AICM transformation programme](https://jubap.eu/aicm-mexico-city-airport-transformation/).
The Nestlé account describes how the dashboard, liberation strategy and six-domain root-cause tool were used as a sequence.
For a complementary reading, see [Diamond Inside: discovering value already present](https://jubap.eu/the-diamond-inside-framework/).
For a complementary reading, see [The Diamond Inside value-discovery framework](https://jubap.eu/the-diamond-inside-framework/).
For a complementary reading, see [Rationalization across a decentralized luxury group](https://jubap.eu/1654-2/).
For a complementary reading, see [Rationalization as value discovery](https://jubap.eu/rationalization-as-value-discovery/).
For a complementary reading, see [Southeast Asia: discovering the regional shadow portfolio](https://jubap.eu/southeast-asia-shadow-it-and-lakehouse-model-rationalization/).
The Japan case details a local discovery–repository–governance sequence within the broader architecture programme.
For a complementary reading, see [Manufacturing capability federation](https://jubap.eu/1557-2/).
In the supply-chain case, process traces were interpreted as evidence for architecture decisions rather than treated as a complete portfolio answer.
The Montblanc MVP and the event-intelligence proposal both examine signals that sales records alone do not preserve.
For a complementary reading, see [A distributed architecture for product intelligence](https://jubap.eu/luxury-recommendation-intelligence/).
For a complementary reading, see [The luxury-group rationalization case](https://jubap.eu/1654-2/).
Regional transfer works best when the reusable capability is separated from the channel that first hosted it.
For a complementary reading, see [Piece identity and custody through the event lifecycle](https://jubap.eu/luxury-piece-identity-dynamic-inventory-orchestration/).
For a complementary reading, see [Architectural translation across the Greater China ecosystem](https://jubap.eu/greater-china-robotics-industrial-ecosystem-architectural-bridge/).
The event-intelligence proposal suggests a lightweight capability-librarian role for making reuse visible across a portfolio.
The AICM programme explicitly describes an adapted JUBAP route; the human-transformation article explains the perspective mechanism without establishing that every technique was used there.
For a complementary reading, see [Nestlé: where the framework was named](https://jubap.eu/nestle-case-study-where-jubap-was-first-named/).
For a complementary reading, see [The JUBAP adaptive transformation framework](https://jubap.eu/the-jubap-framework/).
For a complementary reading, see [Strategic reframing of an existing capability base](https://jubap.eu/reframing-value-creation/).
For a complementary reading, see [The complete Diamond Inside framework](https://jubap.eu/the-diamond-inside-framework/).
For a complementary reading, see [AICM: reframing the workforce as strategic capacity](https://jubap.eu/aicm-mexico-city-airport-transformation/).
For a complementary reading, see [Japan: building horizontal architecture governance](https://jubap.eu/japan-enterprise-architecture-function/).
For a complementary reading, see [China: platform-specific visibility and transfer](https://jubap.eu/china-technology-visibility-and-regional-rationalization/).
For a complementary reading, see [Distributed product knowledge and recommendation](https://jubap.eu/luxury-recommendation-intelligence/).
For a complementary reading, see [Linking identifiers across distributed product knowledge](https://jubap.eu/luxury-recommendation-intelligence/).
La ampliación del marco orienta la búsqueda de capacidades ya disponibles.
El caso permite examinar cómo una intervención se apoya en capacidades y prácticas existentes.
